pair.title: Pair with your eSmart apartment
pair.description:
A new remote device was registered as `{jid}` and is connected.

On your eSmart panel, create a pairing code for a new remote device and enter it here right away (codes expire quickly).

error.invalid_code: The code must be a number.
error.pair_failed: No answer from the controller. The code may have expired; create a new one and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the eSmart server.
error.not_paired: Logged in, but the controller did not invite this device. Is it paired?

abort.cannot_connect: Could not register a new device with the eSmart server.

init.title: Control
init.description:
By default the integration is read-only. Only the devices selected here can be switched from Home Assistant. Leave out sockets that power other equipment. Scenes and holiday mode are never controlled.

Door opening adds a lock per door that releases the door opener, like the door button in the eSmart app. The lock shows “unlocked” for a few seconds after opening; locking does nothing, the door closes by itself. Doors: {doors}.
